messages: elaine (Design): Hey team — pushed a small legend and a 'why we run these probes' one-liner into the network step. Screenshot in the panel. Thoughts on wording? omar (PM): Nice start. Two asks: (1) don't rely on color alone for status — add short text labels next to icons; (2) make the help CTA explicit, e.g. 'How this affects your private deployment' instead of just 'Learn more'. ben (Eng): +1. Also propose the legend is collapsed by default (experienced users don't need it). Show a subtle 'Show legend' link. sasha (DevEx): Microcopy suggestion: prefer 'Reachable / Partial / Blocked' over 'Pass / Warning / Fail' — clearer to non-network folks. elaine (Design): Good call. I'll swap to Reachable/Partial/Blocked. What about aria semantics — @ben any quick guidance? ben (Eng): Use aria-live for status updates and aria-describedby for probe details. Also add visible text labels next to icons so color isn't the only cue. Quick snippet: ``` ⚪️ Reachable ``` And include title attr on the icon for tooltip fallback. accessibility-bot: Automated check — contrast ratio for current 'Partial' yellow label is 3.0:1 (below 4.5:1). Recommend darker hue or increase weight. omar (PM): Let's darken the yellow and re-run visual QA. Also add an inline expandable "If this is blocked, try:" list with SSH/egress debug commands and common tenant firewall hints. sasha (DevEx): For the help CTA placement — prefer inline after the probe summary: 'Why this matters' which opens a right-side panel with step-by-step commands. Make the trigger keyboard-focusable and announceable to screen readers. elaine (Design): I'll iterate the mock: collapsed legend, inline 'Why this matters' link, bolded text labels, and updated yellow. Will post frames by EOD. :thumbsup: ben (Eng): Thanks — quick ask: can someone sanity-test with VoiceOver on macOS? I can only check NVDA/Windows. omar (PM): I'll block 15 mins tomorrow AM to sign off on copy and the QA checklist. sasha (DevEx): Drafting a short acceptance checklist here: - legend collapsed by default - textual labels visible next to icons - aria-live for dynamic probe updates - darker yellow meets 4.5:1 contrast - inline 'Why this matters' opens contextual panel - keyboard focus order verified elaine (Design): Perfect — I'll reference this checklist in the PR and tag the thread. ben (Eng): FYI if anyone wants to prototype the panel behaviour: small pattern we can reuse across other wizards is to slide in an aside panel (not a modal) so users keep context. omar (PM): Love reusability. OK team — let's land the copy + colour tweaks first, then iterate the panel interaction in follow-up. elaine (Design): Thanks all — updating mocks now and will post link.
